instruction: Make the dashboard easier to compare: use dark blue subplot titles with light dashed gridlines, and rename the y-axis to "Comparable value" on the related numeric subplots.
scope_notes: Augmented QC samples use visible-label edit targets.
Reference lines are restricted to standard numeric-y charts.
Relation-augmented samples are designed so one instruction often affects multiple semantically linked subplots.
raw_instruction: Apply comparable styling and aligned numeric y-axis labels.
